Metadata.title: Faris Digital
Metadata.description: Digital products and services in Sudan: game top-ups, Starlink, mobile airtime and app subscriptions.

catalog.title: Products
catalog.intro: Categories, products, options and prices. Changes appear on the site immediately.
catalog.newProductHint: After saving you can add the image and the purchasable options.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.slugHint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. pubg-uc. Changing it changes the page address.
catalog.imageHint: Resize before uploading: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB, between 300 and 4000 px on the longest side (1200×900 is ideal). It is re-encoded to WebP and all metadata is removed.
catalog.noImage: No image yet. The site shows a placeholder tile.
catalog.variantsHint: What the customer chooses and pays for. Prices are set in US dollars.
catalog.noVariantsYet: No options yet. The product is not shown on the site until it has a visible option.
catalog.priceHint: Converted at today's rate: {rate} SDG per USD, rounded up.
catalog.noRate: No exchange rate set yet: prices cannot be shown or ordered.
catalog.requiredFieldsHint: For example the player ID or the account email. Checked on the server for every order.
catalog.sdgPreviewNote: SDG prices follow the exchange rate in Settings; orders keep the price they were placed at.
catalog.snapshotNote: Existing orders keep the name, price and details they were placed with.
catalog.archiveHint: Archiving hides it from the site. Existing orders are not affected; you can restore it later.
catalog.archivedNote: Archived: not shown on the site.
catalog.archiveConfirm: Archive this item? It will disappear from the site.

fields.none: No details asked. The customer only chooses the option.
fields.sensitiveHint: Deleted from the order when it is completed or cancelled (e.g. passwords).

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Values used across the site. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
settings.pricingHint: The exchange rate changes every price shown on the site at once.
settings.kycThresholdHint: Orders at or above this amount need a verified identity.
settings.saveConfirm: Save? New prices apply to new orders immediately.
settings.bannerHint: Shown at the top of the home page when active.
settings.bannerLinkHint: A site path such as /c/games, or a full https:// address.
settings.bannerImageHint: Resize before uploading: wide image, at least 800×200 px, at most 6000 px wide, up to 2 MB. Re-encoded to WebP.
settings.logoHint: Replaces the text logo in the header when set.
settings.logoImageHint: PNG with transparency works best. Between 64 and 2000 px, up to 2 MB.
settings.banksHint: Shown to customers on every unpaid order. Deactivate an account instead of deleting it.
settings.limitsHint: Guards against abuse. Raise them in busy seasons without a new release.
settings.orderLimitHint: Extra orders are refused until the hour passes.
settings.otpBudgetHint: Caps the WhatsApp bill if someone abuses the sign-up form.
settings.otpLoginHint: Sign-up and password reset always use a code.
settings.businessNameHint: Printed on new invoices. Invoices already issued keep the name they were issued with.

admins.title: Admins
admins.intro: Only the owner can add admins and change their permissions.
admins.addHint: The person must already have an account with a verified phone number.
admins.added: Admin added. Now grant their permissions.
admins.ownerNote: The owner has every permission and cannot be changed or removed.
admins.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this admin? They lose access to the dashboard immediately.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every sensitive change: who did it, when, and what changed. Read-only: nobody can edit or delete an entry.
